crossRefs.note: In the fullness of his sufficiency, distress will overtake him. The hand of everyone who is in misery will come on him.
Yes, he would have allured you out of distress, into a wide place, where there is no restriction. That which is set on…
You have enlarged my steps under me, My feet have not slipped.
When you go, your steps will not be hampered. When you run, you will not stumble.
He frustrates the plans of the crafty, So that their hands can’t perform their enterprise.
He takes the wise in their own craftiness; the counsel of the cunning is carried headlong.
Someone told David, saying, “Ahithophel is among the conspirators with Absalom.” David said, “Yahweh, please turn the…
Absalom and all the men of Israel said, “The counsel of Hushai the Archite is better than the counsel of Ahithophel.”…
Yahweh brings the counsel of the nations to nothing. He makes the thoughts of the peoples to be of no effect.
They wanted none of my counsel. They despised all my reproof.
It also will be carried to Assyria for a present to a great king. Ephraim will receive shame, and Israel will be…
For the wisdom of this world is foolishness with God. For it is written, “He has taken the wise in their craftiness.”

translations.web: The steps of his strength will be shortened. His own counsel will cast him down.
translations.bsb: His vigorous stride is shortened, and his own schemes trip him up.
translations.kjv: The steps of his strength shall be straitened, and his own counsel shall cast him down.
translations.asv: The steps of his strength shall be straitened, And his own counsel shall cast him down.
